description.text: Program Highlights a. Eligible teaching base for MBA program by China Scholarship Council b. All course taught in English c. Teachers with overseas academic backgrounds in Europe and USA d. Opportunities to intern at well-known companies and attend international conference e. Lectures of professors from top universities and CEOs from acknowledged companies all over the world Introduction Wuhan University of Technology has established MBA International Education Center, and is the appointed teaching unit of MBA program by China Scholarship Council. All the teachers possess oversea academic backgrounds in Europe and USA. Meanwhile, some famous professors from top universities and CEOs from acknowledged companies all over the world will be invited to give lectures timely. Students will have opportunities to intern at these well-known companies and attend international conference. Teaching Objective The Master of Business Administration Degree for foreign students aims to train high-level and specialized personnel with a good command of basic theories and systematic professional knowledge, and understanding of the frontier trends in the profession in all kinds of enterprises and various areas, including marketing management, financial management, strategy management, production management, technological innovation management, human resources management, and investment decision management. Research Orientation Human Resources Development and Management, Organization and Enterprise Culture, Marketing Management, Strategy for Enterprise Development, Enterprise Information System, Corporation Finance Note: Masters' Degree Programs for Class Formed Only by International Students are required to have as least 12 students in one program. Study Period and Credit Generally the Master of Business Administration Degree is 2-3 year postgraduate program. The period for academic courses study is usually one and half years, and the total credits are no less than 36. Curriculum Chinese, Research Methods of Management, Advanced Management, Management Economics, Marketing Management, Strategic Management for Enterprises, Introduction to China, Management Information System, China: Culture& Enterprises, Accounting, Organizational Behavior, Project Management, Development and Management of Human Resources, E-commerce and web marketing, International Trade and Finance, etc.. Career During the school years, foreign students should investigate at least three units (enterprises, financial units and departments of government, etc.). Before writing thesis, students should carry out investigation on the areas of their selected topics. Postgraduates should take part in the activities organized by their advisers, e.g. enterprise diagnosis, area development, industrial development consultation, etc. The credits of practical part are 45-54. Scientific Research and Thesis During the school years, all the students should actively write and put forward papers on their fields or their related fields in Chinese or foreign academic publications or academic conferences, and should also take active part in research tasks undertaken by their advisers. The topic of master's degree thesis should be of theoretic significance or important application prospects. The University encourages the international students to make research and finish the thesis relating with the actual situation of their home countries. Introduction of Department School of Management is founded in 1964, is one of the earliest departments that starts the domestic management science and engineering disciplines. Within its two broad subject disciplines of Economics and Management, the School has one first-level discipline doctor station, 7 second-level discipline doctor stations,2 first-level discipline master stations, 20 second-level discipline master stations, all with the right to award Masters, PhD and post-doctoral qualifications. It has 2 provincial key first-level disciplines. Note Masters' Degree Programs for Class Formed Only by International Students are required to have as least 12 students in one program.

duration.text: The MBA at Wuhan University of Technology is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4722 USD/per year ￥ 34000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
